QUOTE: "`MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` is off in `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:208`. The dispatch function `mbedtls_calloc` in `platform.c` is compiled only under that gate"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the gate is off in the shipped config, but never says it is commented out in mbedtls_config.h. "Off" is not the same claim.
